evidence_grades.A: A named pair or mixed pair group has an isolated held-out addition/removal comparison. This grades the experiment, not universal validity or statistical significance.
evidence_grades.B: The named feature is present in a successful joint pipeline; its isolated contribution is not established.
evidence_grades.C: A fitted surface or domain result motivates a hypothesis, including transfer to a different dataset.

shared_trial_rules: Keep evidence grade separate from local readiness, estimated effect size, and transfer to a different model.
Engineered ratios are multivariable features. An additive model supplied with them is no longer additive in the original raw features.
An isolated gain over a weak additive representation can reflect missing univariate flexibility. Freeze comparable main effects before pair tests.
Use the source-exact feature and a pairwise spline representation as separate arms; they express different function classes.
